title: Leaving test ignores a referenced case's failed, unlinked observation
symptom: stage advance moves test to accept while the latest observation of a referenced case failed and no bug links it; chough next shows no warning
trigger: In stage test, record a failed observation for a checkpoint case without adding a bug, then chough stage advance
expected: The move is refused until the case passes or a bug links the failed observation
environment: Linux x86_64, main 825a380, SpecSync 6.1.2, Fledge 1.8.0, hi 0.8.0, examples/shipping copy with SDD off
impact: A known failure is left behind at test; FLOW-7 and LIFE-5 are not enforced

notes.text: status: open -> fix-pending-verification. Failing-first gate tests recorded
status: fix-pending-verification -> verified. Fixed in src/stage.rs: refused:unlinked-failure; tests pass and the reproduction is refused

status: verified -> open. Reopened from 0xLeif's PR #43 review (discussion_r4445242804): a later not-run observation of the case clears the refusal, because the latest observation of any outcome is used. Regression test fails before the fix.
status: open -> verified. Fixed: unlinked_failure ignores not-run observations when picking a case's latest result; the regression case passes locally.
